content: Introduction & History of pathology, Basic definitions, and familiarization
with the common terms used in pathology, Causes and mechanisms of cell
injury, reversible and irreversible injury, Introduction of hyperplasia
hypoplasia, hypertrophy, atrophy, metaplasia, necrosis and apoptosis

chapters.chapter_name: Urine Analysis: Urinary system, the composition of urine. Collection &
content: preservation of urine sample. Physical Examination: Volume, Colour
Appearance, Specific gravity, pH
Chemical Examination: Sugar, Protein, Ketone bodies, Bile salt, Bile
pigment, urobilinogen, occult blood, Bence-Jones protein. Microscopic
examination: Cells, crystals, casts, parasites. Pregnancy test-Production of
HCG

chapters.chapter_name: Faeces Analysis: Method of collection. Physical Examination: colour,
content: mucous, consistency. Chemical Examination: Occult blood, faecal
urobilinogen & fat. Microscopic Examination: Pus cells, RBCs, Crystals &
Parasitic trophozoites, ova, cyst, adult parasites.Various concentration
method of microscopic examination

chapters.chapter_name: Sputum Examination: Methods for collection & preservation. Physical
content: examination. Microscopic examination of sputum: crystals, various staining
preparation, concentration method for AFB
Examination of Miscellaneous Body Fluids: Transudate & Exudate
Cerebrospinal fluid, Pleural fluid, Synovial fluid, Gastric juice, Pericardial
fluid, Peritoneal fluid, Semen
